statement: ∀ (bar : Reduction.loc p →+* K), letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra; ∀ (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M)), (∀ f : Module.End ℤ M, Phi.toLinearMap.comp (f.baseChange K) = ((f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p)).baseChange K).comp Phi.toLinearMap) → ∀ (A : Reduction.IntegralOps (act x) (act y) (act h) M) (a : Basis (Reduction.Ind l) (Reduction.loc p) (Reduction.MR p M)) (b : ℂ), (∀ i, Reduction.iota p M (a i) = b • Reduction.e (act y) v0 i.val) → Reduction.generatorFormulas l (A.ix.baseChange K) (A.iy.baseChange K) (A.ih.baseChange K) (Reduction.extendBasis l ((a.baseChange K).map Phi.symm))
proof:
intro bar
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
intro Phi hPhi A a b ha
let beta := (a.baseChange K).map Phi.symm

have hb (i : ℕ) (hi : i < l.toNat + 1) :
    Reduction.extendBasis l beta i = beta ⟨i, hi⟩ := by simp [Reduction.extendBasis, hi]
have hg := h_T002.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
change Reduction.generatorFormulas l (A.ix.baseChange K) (A.iy.baseChange K) (A.ih.baseChange K) (Reduction.extendBasis l beta)
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· rw [hb 0 (by omega)]
  simpa [beta] using tr A.ix (act x) A.ix_spec (hPhi A.ix) ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨0, by omega⟩ 0 (by simpa using hg.1)
· intro i hi
  rw [hb (i+1) (by omega), hb i (by omega)]
  simpa only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_natCast] using
    tr A.ix (act x) A.ix_spec (hPhi A.ix) ⟨i+1, by omega⟩ ⟨i, by omega⟩ (l - (i : ℤ)) (by simpa using hg.2.1 i hi)
· intro i hi
  rw [hb i (by omega), hb (i+1) (by omega)]
  simpa only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one] using
    tr A.iy (act y) A.iy_spec (hPhi A.iy) ⟨i, by omega⟩ ⟨i+1, by omega⟩ ((i : ℤ)+1) (by simpa using hg.2.2.1 i hi)
· rw [hb l.toNat (by omega)]
  simpa [beta] using tr A.iy (act y) A.iy_spec (hPhi A.iy) ⟨l.toNat, by omega⟩ ⟨0, by omega⟩ 0 (by simpa using hg.2.2.2.1)
· intro i hi
  rw [hb i (by omega)]
  simpa only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_ofNat, Int.cast_natCast] using
    tr A.ih (act h) A.ih_spec (hPhi A.ih) ⟨i, by omega⟩ ⟨i, by omega⟩ (l - 2 * (i : ℤ)) (by simpa using hg.2.2.2.2 i hi)

  Nat.Prime p →

      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M →
                Reduction.scalarFacts p K M →
                  ∀ (bar : ↥(Reduction.loc p) →+* K)
                    (Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[↥(Reduction.loc p)] Reduction.MR p M),
                    (∀ (f : End ℤ ↥M),
                        ↑Phi ∘ₗ LinearMap.baseChange K f =
                          LinearMap.baseChange K (LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) ∘ₗ ↑Phi) →

                            (LinearMap.baseChange K A.ih)
                            (Reduction.extendBasis l ((Basis.baseChange K a).map Phi.symm))
